In aayaton mein Allah Ta'ala Ummat-e-Muslima ko apne Nabi ke aadaab sikhata hai ke tumhein apne Nabi ki tauqeer-o-ehtram, izzat-o-azmat ka khayal karna chahiye. Tamam kaamon mein Allah aur Rasool ke peeche rehna chahiye, itteba aur tabedari ki khoo daalni chahiye. Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ko jab Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne Yaman ki taraf bheja to daryaft farmaya, "Apne ehkamat ke nifaz ki bunyad kise banaoge?" Jawab diya, "Allah ki Kitab ko." Farmaya, "Agar na pao?" Jawab diya, "Sunnat ko." Farmaya, "Agar na pao?" Jawab diya, "Ijtihad karunga." To Aap (ﷺ) ne un ke seene par haath rakh kar farmaya, "Allah ka shukr hai jis ne Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke qasid ko aisi taufiq di jis se Allah ka Rasool khush ho." (Abu Dawood, Tirmidhi, Ibn Majah). Yahan is hadith ke waarid karne se hamara maqsad yeh hai ke Hazrat Mu'az (R.A) ne apni raye, nazar aur ijtihad ko Kitab-o-Sunnat se mu'akhar rakha. Pas Kitab-o-Sunnat par raye ko muqaddam karna Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) se aage barhna hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain matlab yeh hai ke Kitab-o-Sunnat ke khilaf na kaho. Hazrat Aufi farmate hain Huzoor (ﷺ) ke kalam ke samne bolne se mana kar diya gaya. Mujahid farmate hain ke jab tak kisi amr ki babat Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) kuch na farmayein tum khamosh raho. Hazrat Zahhak farmate hain amr-e-deen, ehkam-e-shari mein siwaye Allah ke kalam aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki hadith ke tum kisi aur cheez se faisla na karo. Hazrat Sufyan Sauri ka irshad hai kisi qaul-o-fe'l mein Allah aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ) par pehal na karo. Imam Hasan Basri farmate hain murad yeh hai ke Imam se pehle dua na karo. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain ke log kehte hain agar falan falan mein hukm utre to is tarah rakhna chahiye, ise Allah ne na-pasand farmaya. Phir irshad hota hai ke hukm-e-Allah ki baja-awari mein Allah ka lihaz rakho, Allah tumhari baatein sun raha hai aur tumhare irade jaan raha hai. Phir dusra adab sikhata hai ke woh Nabi (ﷺ) ki aawaz par apni aawaz buland na karein. Yeh aayat Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) ke bare mein nazil hui. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein Hazrat Ibn Abi Mulaika se marwi hai ke qareeb tha ke woh behtareen hastiyan halak ho jayein, yani Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddiq (R.A) aur Hazrat Umar Farooq (R.A). In dono ki aawazein Huzoor (ﷺ) ke samne buland ho gayin jabke Banu Tamim ka wafd hazir hua tha. Ek to Aqra bin Habis ko kehte the jo Bani Mujasha mein the aur dusre shakhs ki babat kehte the. Is par Hazrat Siddiq (R.A) ne farmaya ke tum to mere khilaf hi kiya karte ho. Farooq-e-Azam (R.A) ne jawab diya, "Nahin nahin, aap yeh khayal bhi na farmaiye." Is par yeh aayat nazil hui. Hazrat Ibn Zubair (R.A) farmate hain is ke baad to Hazrat Umar (R.A) is tarah Huzoor (ﷺ) se narm kalami karte the ke Aap (ﷺ) ko dobara puchna parta tha.

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) farmate thay Qaa'qaa bin Ma'bad ko is wafd ka ameer banaiye aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) farmate thay nahin balkay Hazrat Aqra bin Habis ko, is ikhtilaf mein aawazein kuch buland ho gayin jis par aayat (Yaa Ayyuhallazina Aamanu Laa Tuqaddimu Baina Yadayillahi Wa Rasulihi Wattaqullaha Innallaha Sami'un 'Alim) (Al-Hujurat: 1) nazil hui aur aayat (Wa Law Annahum Sabaru Hatta Takhruja Ilaihim Lakana Khairal Lahum Wallahu Ghafurur Rahim) (Al-Hujurat: 5), Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai aayat (Yaa Ayyuhallazina Aamanu Laa Tarfa'u Aswatakum Fawqa Sawtin Nabiyyi Wa Laa Tajharu Lahu Bil-Qawli Kajahri Ba'dikum Liba'din An Tahbata A'malukum Wa Antum Laa Tash'urun) (Al-Hujurat: 2), ke nazil hone ke baad Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Qasam Allah ki ab toh main aap se is tarah baatein karunga jis tarah koi sargoshi karta hai. Sahih Bukhari mein hai ke Hazrat Thabit bin Qais (R.A) kayi din tak Huzoor (ﷺ) ki majlis mein nazar na aaye, is par ek shakhs ne kaha Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ)! Main is ki babat aap ko bataunga, chunancha woh Hazrat Thabit (R.A) ke makan par aaye, dekha ke woh sar jhukaye hue baithe hain. Poocha kya haal hai? Jawab mila bura haal hai, main toh Hazrat (ﷺ) ki aawaz par apni aawaz ko buland karta tha, mere a'maal barbad ho gaye aur main jahannami ban gaya. Yeh shakhs Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur sara waqia aap (ﷺ) se keh sunaya, phir toh Huzoor (ﷺ) ke farman se ek zabardast basharat le kar dobara Hazrat Thabit (R.A) ke haan gaye, Huzoor (ﷺ) ne farmaya tum jao aur un se kaho ke tu jahannami nahin balkay jannati hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein bhi yeh waqia hai, is mein yeh bhi hai ke khud Huzoor (ﷺ) ne poocha tha ke Thabit kahan hain nazar nahin aate. Is ke aakhir mein hai Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain hum unhein zinda chalta phirta dekhte thay aur jaante thay ke woh ahl-e-jannat mein se hain. Yamama ki jang mein jab ke musalman qadray bad-dil ho gaye toh hum ne dekha ke Hazrat Thabit (R.A) khushbu malay, kafan pehne hue dushman ki taraf barhte chale ja rahe hain aur farma rahe hain musalmano tum log apne baad walon ke liye bura namuna na chhor jao, yeh keh kar dushmanon mein ghus gaye aur bahadurana larte rahe yahan tak ke shaheed ho gaye (R.A). Sahih Muslim Shareef mein hai aap (ﷺ) ne jab unhein nahin dekha toh Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) se jo un ke parosi thay daryaft farmaya ke kya Thabit bimar hain? Lekin is hadith ki aur sanadon mein Hazrat Sa'ad (R.A) ka zikr nahin, is se sabit hota hai ke yeh riwayat mu'allal hai aur yahi baat sahih bhi hai, is liye ke Hazrat Sa'ad bin Mu'az (R.A) us waqt zinda hi na thay balkay aap ka inteqal Banu Quraiza ki jang ke baad thore hi dinon mein ho gaya tha aur Banu Quraiza ki jang san 5 Hijri mein hui thi aur yeh aayat wafd-e-Bani Tamim ki aamad ke waqt utri hai aur wufood ka pay dar pay aane ka waqia san 9 Hijri ka hai, Wallahu A'lam.

Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai jab yeh aayat utri toh Hazrat Thabit bin Qais raaste mein baith gaye aur rone lage. Hazrat Asim bin Adi jab wahan se guzre aur unhein rote dekha toh sabab daryaft kiya. Jawab mila ke mujhe khauf hai ke kahin yeh aayat mere hi baare mein nazil na hui ho, meri aawaz buland hai. Hazrat Asim yeh sun kar chale gaye aur Hazrat Thabit ki hichki bandh gayi, dhaarein maar maar kar rone lage aur apni biwi sahiba Hazrat Jamila bint-e-Abdullah bin Ubayy bin Salool se kaha main apne ghode ke tawayle mein ja raha hoon tum is ka darwaza bahar se band kar ke lohe ki keel se ise jad do. Allah ki qasam main is mein se na niklunga yahan tak ke ya mar jaaun ya Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko mujh se razamand kar de. Yahan toh yeh hua wahan jab Hazrat Asim ne darbar-e-Risalat mein Hazrat Thabit ki halat bayan ki toh Risalat-ma'ab (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hukum diya ke tum jao aur Thabit ko mere paas bula lao. Lekin Asim us jagah aaye toh dekha ke Hazrat Thabit wahan nahin, makan par gaye toh maloom hua ke woh toh ghode ke tawayle mein hain. Yahan aa kar kaha Thabit chalo tum ko Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) yaad farma rahe hain. Hazrat Thabit ne kaha bahut khoob, keel nikal daalo aur darwaza khol do, phir bahar nikal kar sarkar mein hazir hue toh aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne rone ki wajah poochhi jis ka sacha jawab Hazrat Thabit se sun kar aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya kya tum is baat se khush nahin ho ke tum qabil-e-tareef zindagi guzaro aur shaheed ho kar maro aur jannat mein jao. Is par Hazrat Thabit ka sara ranj kafoor ho gaya aur baachhein khul gayin aur farmane lage ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) main Allah Ta'ala ki aur aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki is basharat par bahut khush hoon aur ab aayinda kabhi bhi apni aawaz aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki aawaz se oonchi na karunga. Is par is ke baad ki aayat (Innal-lazina yaghudduna aswatahum inda Rasoolillahi ula'ikal-lazinam-tahanallahu qulubahum lit-taqwa, lahum maghfiratun wa ajrun azeem) (Al-Hujurat: 3) al-kh, nazil hui, yeh qissa isi tarah kayi ek tabieen se bhi marwi hai. Al-gharaz Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne aawaz buland karne se mana farma diya. Ameer-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab (R.A) ne do shakhson ki kuch buland aawazein Masjid-e-Nabvi mein sun kar wahan aa kar un se farmaya tumhein maloom hai ke tum kahan ho? Phir un se poochha ke tum kahan ke rehne wale ho? Unhon ne kaha Taif ke. Aap (R.A) ne farmaya agar tum Madine ke hote toh main tumhein poori saza deta. Ulama-e-Kiram ka farman hai ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki qabr-e-shareef ke paas bhi buland aawaz se bolna makrooh hai jaise ke aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki hayat mein aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne makrooh tha, is liye ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jis tarah apni zindagi mein qabil-e-ehtram-o-izzat thay ab aur hamesha tak aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) apni qabr-e-shareef mein bhi ba-izzat aur qabil-e-ehtram hi hain. Phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se baatein karte hue jis tarah aam logon se ba-aawaz-e-buland baatein karte hain baatein karni mana farmayin, balki aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se taskeen-o-waqar, izzat-o-adab, hurmat-o-azmat se baatein karni chahiyen.

Jaise aur jagah hai aayat (LAA TAJ'ALOO DU'AAR-RASOOLI BAINAKUM KADU'AA-I BA'DIKUM BA'DAA. QAD YA'LAMULLAHUL-LADHEENA YATASALLALOONA MINKUM LIWAAZAA. FALYAHDHARIL-LADHEENA YUKHALIFOONA 'AN AMRIHEE AN TUSEEBAHUM FITNATUN AW YUSEEBAHUM 'ADHAABUN ALEEM) (24-An-Noor: 63). Aye Musalmano! Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko is tarah na pukaro jis tarah tum aapas mein ek dusre ko pukarte ho, phir farmata hai ke hum ne tumhein is buland aawaz se is liye roka hai ke aisa na ho kisi waqt Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) naraz ho jayen aur aap ki narazgi ki wajah se Allah naraz ho jaye aur tumhare kul a'maal zabt kar le aur tumhein is ka pata bhi na chale. Chunancha Sahih Hadith mein hai ke ek shakhs Allah ki razamandi ka koi kalma aisa keh guzarta hai, ke us ke nazdeek to us kalma ki koi ahmiyat nahin hoti, lekin Allah ko woh itna pasand aata hai ke us ki wajah se woh jannati ho jata hai. Isi tarah insaan Allah ki narazgi ka koi aisa kalma keh jata hai ke us ke nazdeek to us ki koi wa'qat nahin hoti lekin Allah Ta'ala use us ek kalma ki wajah se jahannam ke is qadar neeche ke tabqe mein pahuncha deta hai ke jo garha aasman-o-zameen se zyada gehra hai. Phir Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala aap ke samne aawaz past karne ki raghbat deta hai aur farmata hai ke jo log Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke samne apni aawazein dheemi karte hain unhein Allah Rabbul-Izzat ne taqwe ke liye khalis kar liya hai, ahl-e-taqwa aur mahall-e-taqwa yahi log hain. Yeh Allah ki maghfirat ke mustahiq aur ajr-e-azeem ke laiq hain. Imam Ahmad ne Kitab-uz-Zuhd mein ek riwayat naqal ki hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) se ek tahreeran istifta liya gaya ke aye Ameer-ul-Momineen! Ek woh shakhs jise nafarmani ki khwahish hi na ho aur na koi nafarmani us ne ki ho, woh aur woh shakhs jise khwahish-e-ma'siyat hai lekin woh bura kaam nahin karta, to in mein se afzal kaun hai? Aap ne jawab mein likha ke jinhein ma'siyat ki khwahish hoti hai phir nafarmaniyon se bachte hain, yahi log hain jin ke dilon ko Allah Ta'ala ne parhezgari ke liye aazma liya hai, in ke liye maghfirat hai aur bahut bada ajr-o-sawab hai.

Jawab diya, "Sunnat ko." Farmaya, "Agar na pao?" Jawab diya, "Ijtihad karunga." Hazrat Zaid bin Arqam farmate hain ke kuch Arab jama hue aur kehne lage, "Hamein is shakhs ke paas le chalo, agar woh sacha Nabi hai toh sab se zyada is se sa'adat hasil karne ke mustahiq hum hain aur agar woh badshah hai toh hum is ke paron tale pal jayenge." Main ne aa kar Huzoor (ﷺ) se yeh waqia bayan kiya, phir woh log aaye aur hujre ke peeche se Aap ka naam le kar Aap ko pukarne lage, is par yeh aayat utri. Huzoor (ﷺ) ne mera kaan pakar kar farmaya, "Allah Ta'ala ne teri baat sachi kar di, Allah Ta'ala ne teri baat sachi kar di." (Ibn-e-Jarir))

Fasiq ki khabar par aitimaad na karo. Allah Ta'ala hukum deta hai ke fasiq ki khabar ka aitimaad na karo jab tak poori tehqeeq-o-tafteesh se asal waqia saaf taur par maloom na ho jaye koi harkat na karo. Mumkin hai ke kisi fasiq shakhs ne koi jhooti baat keh di ho ya khud us se ghalti hui ho aur tum us ki khabar ke mutabiq koi kaam kar guzro to asal us ki pairwi hogi aur mufsid logon ki pairwi haram hai. Isi ayat ko daleel bana kar baaz muhaddiseen-e-kiram ne us shakhs ki riwayat ko bhi ghair motabar bataya hai jis ka haal na maloom ho, is liye ke bohat mumkin hai yeh shakhs filwaqia fasiq ho, go baaz logon ne aise majhool-ul-haal rawiyon ki riwayat li bhi hai, aur unhon ne kaha hai ke hamain fasiq ki khabar qabool karne se mana kiya gaya hai aur jis ka haal maloom nahin us ka fasiq hona hum par zahir nahin. Hum ne is maslay ki poori wazahat se Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki sharah mein Kitab-ul-Ilm mein bayan kar diya hai, falhamdulillah. Aksar mufassireen-e-kiram ne farmaya hai ke yeh ayat Waleed bin Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait ke baray mein nazil hui hai jabke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne unhein qabeela Banu Mustaliq se zakat lene ke liye bheja tha. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai, Hazrat Haris bin Zirar Khuza'i jo Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Juwairiya (R.A) ke walid hain farmate hain: Main Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua, Aap ne mujhe Islam ki dawat di jo main ne manzoor kar li aur musalman ho gaya. Phir Aap ne zakat ki farziyat sunayi, main ne us ka bhi iqrar kiya aur kaha ke main wapas apni qoum mein jata hoon aur un mein se jo iman layein aur zakat ada karein main un ki zakat jama karta hoon, itnay itnay dinon ke baad Aap meri taraf kisi aadmi ko bhej dijiye, main us ke haath jama shuda maal-e-zakat Aap ki khidmat mein bhijwa doon ga. Hazrat Haris ne wapas aa kar yahi kiya, maal-e-zakat jama kiya. Jab waqt-e-muqarrara guzar chuka aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ki taraf se koi qasid na aaya to Aap ne apni qoum ke sardaron ko jama kiya aur un se kaha: Yeh to namumkin hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) apne waaday ke mutabiq apna koi aadmi na bhejein, mujhe to dar hai ke kahin kisi wajah se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum se naraz na ho gaye hon? Aur is bina par Aap ne apna koi qasid maal-e-zakat le jaane ke liye na bheja ho. Agar aap log muttafiq hon to hum is maal ko le kar khud hi Madina Sharif chalein aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein pesh kar dein. Yeh tajweez tay ho gayi aur yeh hazrat apna maal-e-zakat saath le kar chal kharay hue. Udhar se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Waleed bin Uqba ko apna qasid bana kar bhej chukay thay lekin yeh hazrat raastay hi mein se dar ke maaray laut aaye aur yahan aa kar keh diya ke Haris ne zakat bhi rok li aur mere qatl ke darpay ho gaya. Is par An-Hazrat (ﷺ) naraz hue aur kuch aadmi tanbeeh ke liye rawana farmaye. Madina ke qareeb raastay hi mein is mukhtasar se lashkar ne Hazrat Haris ko pa liya aur gher liya. Hazrat Haris ne poocha: Aakhir kya baat hai? Tum kahan aur kis ke paas ja rahay ho? Unhon ne kaha: Hum teri taraf bhejay gaye hain. Poocha: Kyun?

Kaha is liye ke tu ne Huzoor ﷺ ke qasid Waleed ko zakat na di balkay unhein qatl karna chaha. Aap ne jawab diya hargiz nahin Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ qasam hai Allah ki jis ne Aap ko sacha Rasool bana kar bheja hai na main ne unhein dekha na woh mere paas aaye. Tabrani mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ ka qasid Hazrat Haris ki basti ke paas pahuncha to yeh log khush ho kar us ke istiqbal ke liye khas tayari kar ke niklay idhar un ke dil mein yeh shaitani khayal paida hua ke yeh log mujh se larnay ke liye aa rahay hain to yeh laut kar wapas chalay aaye unhon ne jab yeh dekha ke Aap ke qasid wapas chalay gaye to khud hi hazir hue aur Zohar ki namaz ke baad saf-basta kharay ho kar arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah Aap ne zakat wasool karne ke liye apne aadmi ko bheja hamari aankhein thandi huin hum behad khush hue lekin Allah janay kya hua ke woh rastay mein se hi laut gaye to is khauf se ke kahin Allah hum se naraz na ho gaya ho hum hazir hue hain isi tarah woh uzr-e-mazrat karte rahay Asr ki azan jab Hazrat Bilal ne di us waqt yeh aayat nazil hui, aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Waleed ki is khabar par abhi Huzoor ﷺ soch hi rahay thay ke kuch aadmi un ki taraf bhejein ke un ka wafd aa gaya aur unhon ne kaha Aap ka qasid aadhay rastay se hi laut gaya to hum ne khayal kiya ke Aap ne kisi narazgi ki bina par unhein wapsi ka hukum bhej diya hoga is liye hazir hue hain, hum Allah ke ghussay se aur Aap ki narazgi se Allah ki panah chahtay hain pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari aur us ka uzr sacha bataya. Aur riwayat mein hai ke qasid ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke in logon ne to Aap se larnay ke liye lashkar jama kar liya hai aur Islam se murtad ho gaye hain chunancha Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed ki zer-e-imarat ek fauji dastay ko bhej diya lekin unhein farma diya tha ke pehle tehqeeq-o-taftish achi tarah kar lena jaldi se hamla na kar dena. Isi ke mutabiq Hazrat Khalid ne wahan pahunch kar apne jasoos shehar mein bhej diye woh khabar laye ke woh log Deen-e-Islam par qaim hain masjid mein azanein huin jinhein hum ne khud suna aur logon ko namaz parhtay hue khud dekha, subh hotay hi Hazrat Khalid khud gaye aur wahan ke Islami manzar se khush hue wapas aa kar Sarkar-e-Nabvi mein sari khabar di. Is par yeh aayat utri. Hazrat Qatada jo is waqiye ko bayan karte hain kehte hain ke Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke tehqeeq-o-talash bardbari aur door-beeni Allah ki taraf se hai.

Aur ujlat aur jald bazi shaitan ki taraf se hai. Salaf mein se Hazrat Qatada R.H ke ilawa aur bhi bahut se hazrat ne yahi zikr kiya hai jaise Ibn Abi Laila, Yazid bin Rumaan, Zahhak, Muqatil bin Hayyan waghera. In sab ka bayan hai ke yeh aayat Walid bin Uqba ke bare mein nazil hui hai wallahu a'lam. Phir farmata hai ke jaan lo ke tum mein Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) maujood hain unki ta'zeem-o-tauqeer karna izzat-o-adab karna unke ahkaam ko sar aankhon se baja lana tumhara farz hai woh tumhari maslahaton se bahut aagah hain unhein tum se bahut mohabbat hai woh tumhein mushaqqat mein daalna nahin chahte. Tum apni bhalai ke itne khwahan aur itne waqif nahin ho jitne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hain chunancha aur jagah irshad hai aayat (An-Nabiyyu awla bil-mu'mineena min anfusihim wa azwajuhu ummahatuhum, wa ulul-arhame ba'duhum awla bibad'in fi kitabillahi minal-mu'mineena wal-muhajireena illa an taf'alu ila awliya'ikum ma'rufan, kana dhalika fil-kitabi mastura) (Al-Ahzab: 6) yani musalmanon ke mamlat mein unki apni ba-nisbat Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) unke liye zyada khair-andesh hain. Phir bayan farmaya ke logo tumhari aqlein tumhari maslahaton aur bhalaiyon ko nahin pa saktin unhein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) pa rahe hain. Pas agar woh tumhari har pasandidagi ki raye par aamil bante rahein to is mein tumhara hi haraj waqay hoga. Jaise aur aayat mein hai (Wa lawittaba'al-haqqu ahwa'ahum lafasadatissamaawati wal-ardu wa man feehinna, bal ataynahum bidhikrihim fahum 'an dhikrihim mu'ridun) (Al-Mu'minun: 71) yani agar saccha Rab unki khushi par chale to aasman-o-zameen aur unke darmiyan ki har cheez kharab ho jaye yeh nahin balkay hum ne unhein unki nasihat pahuncha di hai lekin yeh apni nasihat par dhyan hi nahin dharte. Phir farmata hai ke Allah ne imaan ko tumhare nafs-on mein mehboob bana diya hai aur tumhare dilon mein iski umdagi bitha di hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Islam zahir hai aur imaan dil mein hai phir aap apne seene ki taraf teen baar ishara karte aur farmate taqwa yahan hai parhezgari ki jagah yeh hai. Is ne tumhare dilon mein kabira gunah aur tamam nafarmaniyon ki adawat daal di hai is tarah ba-tadreej tum par apni ne'matein bharpoor kar di hain. Phir irshad hota hai jin mein yeh paak ausaf hain unhein Allah ne rushd neki hidayat aur bhalai de rakhi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Uhud ke din jab mushrikeen toot pade to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya durustagi ke sath theek-thaak ho jao taake main apne Rab Azza-wa-Jal ki sana bayan karoon pas log aap ke peeche safein baandh kar khade ho gaye aur aap ne yeh dua padhi (Allahumma lakal-hamdu kulluhu, Allahumma la qabida lima basatta, wa la basita lima qabazta, wa la hadiya liman adlalta, wa la mudilla liman hadayta, wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wa la mani'a lima a'tayta, wa la muqarraba lima ba'adta, wa la muba'ida lima qarrabta. Allahummabsut 'alayna min barakatika wa rahmatika wa fadlika wa rizqika).

Allahumma inni as'alukan-na'imal-muqimallazi la yahulu wa la yazulu, Allahumma inni as'alukan-na'ima yawmal-'ailati wa la amna yawmal-khawfi, Allahumma inni 'a'izu bika min sharri ma a'taitana wa min sharri ma mana'tana, Allahumma habbib ilaynal-imana wa zayyinhu fi qulubina wa karrih ilaynal-kufra wal-fusuqa wal-'isyana waj'alna minar-rashidin, Allahumma tawaffana muslimina wa ahyina muslimina walhiqna bissalihin ghayra khazaya wa la maftunin, Allahumma qatilil-kafaratal-lazina yukazzibuna rusulaka wa yasudduna 'an sabilika waj'al 'alayhim rijzaka wa 'azabaka, Allahumma qatilil-kafaratal-lazina utul-kitaba ilahal-haqq (Nasa'i). Ya'ni: Aye Allah! Tamam tar tareef tere hi liye hai, tu jise kushadgi de use koi tang nahin kar sakta aur jis par tu tangi kare use koi kushada nahin kar sakta, tu jise gumrah kare use koi hidayat nahin de sakta aur jise tu hidayat de use koi gumrah nahin kar sakta, jis se tu rok le use koi de nahin sakta aur jise tu de us se koi baaz nahin rakh sakta, jise tu door kar de use qareeb karne wala koi nahin aur jise tu qareeb kar le use door dalne wala koi nahin. Aye Allah! Hum par apni barkatein, rahmatein, fazl aur rizq kushada kar de. Aye Allah! Main tujh se woh hamesha ki ne'matein chahta hoon jo na idhar udhar hon, na zail hon. Allah! Faqeeri aur ehtiyaaj wale din mujhe apni ne'matein ata farmana aur khauf wale din mujhe amn ata farmana. Parwardigar! Jo tu ne mujhe de rakha hai aur jo nahin diya, un sab ki burai se teri panah mangta hoon. Aye mere Ma'bood! Hamare dilon mein imaan ki mohabbat daal de aur ise hamari nazron mein zeenat-dar bana de aur kufr, badkari aur nafarmani se hamare dil mein doori aur adawat paida kar de aur hamein raah-yafta logon mein kar de. Aye hamare Rabb! Hamein Islam ki halat mein faut kar aur Islam par hi zinda rakh aur nek-kaar logon se mila de, hum ruswa na hon, hum fitne mein na dale jayen. Allah! Un kafiron ka satyanas kar jo tere Rasoolon ko jhutlayen aur teri raah se rokein, tu un par apni saza aur apna azab nazil farma. Ilahi! Ahl-e-Kitab ke kafiron ko bhi tabah kar, aye sache Ma'bood. Yeh hadith Imam Nasa'i (R.H) bhi apni kitab 'Amal al-Yawm wal-Laylah' mein laye hain. Marfoo' hadith mein hai: Jis shakhs ko apni neki achi lage aur burai use naraz kare woh momin hai. Phir farmata hai: Yeh bakhshish jo tumhein ata hui hai yeh tum par Allah ka fazl hai aur uski ne'mat hai, Allah mustahiqeen-e-hidayat ko aur mustahiqeen-e-zalalat ko bakhoobi janta hai, woh apne aqwal-o-af'aal mein Hakeem hai.

Phir bayan farmaya ke logo tumhari aqlein tumhari maslahaton aur bhalaiyon ko nahin pa saktin unhein Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) pa rahe hain. Phir farmata hai ke Allah ne imaan ko tumhare nafs-on mein mehboob bana diya hai aur tumhare dilon mein iski umdagi bitha di hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Rasool-e-Maqbool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Islam zahir hai aur imaan dil mein hai phir aap apne seene ki taraf teen baar ishara karte aur farmate taqwa yahan hai parhezgari ki jagah yeh hai. Phir irshad hota hai jin mein yeh paak ausaf hain unhein Allah ne rushd neki hidayat aur bhalai de rakhi hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Uhud ke din jab mushrikeen toot pade to Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya durustagi ke sath theek-thaak ho jao taake main apne Rab Azza-wa-Jal ki sana bayan karoon pas log aap ke peeche safein baandh kar khade ho gaye aur aap ne yeh dua padhi (Allahumma lakal-hamdu kulluhu, Allahumma la qabida lima basatta, wa la basita lima qabazta, wa la hadiya liman adlalta, wa la mudilla liman hadayta, wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta, wa la mani'a lima a'tayta, wa la muqarraba lima ba'adta, wa la muba'ida lima qarrabta. Allahummabsut 'alayna min barakatika wa rahmatika wa fadlika wa rizqika).

Faqeeri aur ehtiyaaj wale din mujhe apni ne'matein ata farmana aur khauf wale din mujhe amn ata farmana. Parwardigar! Fasiq ki khabar par aitimaad na karo. Allah Ta'ala hukum deta hai ke fasiq ki khabar ka aitimaad na karo jab tak poori tehqeeq-o-tafteesh se asal waqia saaf taur par maloom na ho jaye koi harkat na karo. Mumkin hai ke kisi fasiq shakhs ne koi jhooti baat keh di ho ya khud us se ghalti hui ho aur tum us ki khabar ke mutabiq koi kaam kar guzro to asal us ki pairwi hogi aur mufsid logon ki pairwi haram hai. Isi ayat ko daleel bana kar baaz muhaddiseen-e-kiram ne us shakhs ki riwayat ko bhi ghair motabar bataya hai jis ka haal na maloom ho, is liye ke bohat mumkin hai yeh shakhs filwaqia fasiq ho, go baaz logon ne aise majhool-ul-haal rawiyon ki riwayat li bhi hai, aur unhon ne kaha hai ke hamain fasiq ki khabar qabool karne se mana kiya gaya hai aur jis ka haal maloom nahin us ka fasiq hona hum par zahir nahin. Hum ne is maslay ki poori wazahat se Sahih Bukhari Sharif ki sharah mein Kitab-ul-Ilm mein bayan kar diya hai, falhamdulillah. Aksar mufassireen-e-kiram ne farmaya hai ke yeh ayat Waleed bin Uqba bin Abu Mu'ait ke baray mein nazil hui hai jabke Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ne unhein qabeela Banu Mustaliq se zakat lene ke liye bheja tha. Chunancha Musnad-e-Ahmed mein hai, Hazrat Haris bin Zirar Khuza'i jo Umm-ul-Momineen Hazrat Juwairiya (R.A) ke walid hain farmate hain: Main Rasool Allah (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein hazir hua, Aap ne mujhe Islam ki dawat di jo main ne manzoor kar li aur musalman ho gaya. Phir Aap ne zakat ki farziyat sunayi, main ne us ka bhi iqrar kiya aur kaha ke main wapas apni qoum mein jata hoon aur un mein se jo iman layein aur zakat ada karein main un ki zakat jama karta hoon, itnay itnay dinon ke baad Aap meri taraf kisi aadmi ko bhej dijiye, main us ke haath jama shuda maal-e-zakat Aap ki khidmat mein bhijwa doon ga. Hazrat Haris ne wapas aa kar yahi kiya, maal-e-zakat jama kiya. Jab waqt-e-muqarrara guzar chuka aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ki taraf se koi qasid na aaya to Aap ne apni qoum ke sardaron ko jama kiya aur un se kaha: Yeh to namumkin hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) apne waaday ke mutabiq apna koi aadmi na bhejein, mujhe to dar hai ke kahin kisi wajah se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) hum se naraz na ho gaye hon? Aur is bina par Aap ne apna koi qasid maal-e-zakat le jaane ke liye na bheja ho. Agar aap log muttafiq hon to hum is maal ko le kar khud hi Madina Sharif chalein aur Huzoor (ﷺ) ki khidmat mein pesh kar dein. Yeh tajweez tay ho gayi aur yeh hazrat apna maal-e-zakat saath le kar chal kharay hue. Udhar se Rasool Allah (ﷺ) Waleed bin Uqba ko apna qasid bana kar bhej chukay thay lekin yeh hazrat raastay hi mein se dar ke maaray laut aaye aur yahan aa kar keh diya ke Haris ne zakat bhi rok li aur mere qatl ke darpay ho gaya. Is par An-Hazrat (ﷺ) naraz hue aur kuch aadmi tanbeeh ke liye rawana farmaye. Madina ke qareeb raastay hi mein is mukhtasar se lashkar ne Hazrat Haris ko pa liya aur gher liya. Hazrat Haris ne poocha: Aakhir kya baat hai? Tum kahan aur kis ke paas ja rahay ho? Unhon ne kaha: Hum teri taraf bhejay gaye hain. Poocha: Kyun?

Kaha is liye ke tu ne Huzoor ﷺ ke qasid Waleed ko zakat na di balkay unhein qatl karna chaha. Hazrat Haris ne kaha qasam hai us Allah ki jis ne Muhammad ﷺ ko sacha Rasool bana kar bheja hai na main ne usay dekha na woh mere paas aaya chalo main to khud Huzoor ﷺ ki khidmat mein hazir ho raha hoon yahan aaye to Huzoor ﷺ ne un se daryaft farmaya ke tu ne zakat bhi rok li aur mere aadmi ko bhi qatl karna chaha. Aap ne jawab diya hargiz nahin Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ qasam hai Allah ki jis ne Aap ko sacha Rasool bana kar bheja hai na main ne unhein dekha na woh mere paas aaye. Balkay qasid ko na dekh kar is dar ke maaray ke kahin Allah Ta'ala aur us ke Rasool ﷺ mujh se naraz na ho gaye hon aur isi wajah se qasid na bheja ho main khud hazir-e-khidmat hua, is par yeh aayat (Hakeem) tak nazil hui. Tabrani mein yeh bhi hai ke jab Huzoor ﷺ ka qasid Hazrat Haris ki basti ke paas pahuncha to yeh log khush ho kar us ke istiqbal ke liye khas tayari kar ke niklay idhar un ke dil mein yeh shaitani khayal paida hua ke yeh log mujh se larnay ke liye aa rahay hain to yeh laut kar wapas chalay aaye unhon ne jab yeh dekha ke Aap ke qasid wapas chalay gaye to khud hi hazir hue aur Zohar ki namaz ke baad saf-basta kharay ho kar arz kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah Aap ne zakat wasool karne ke liye apne aadmi ko bheja hamari aankhein thandi huin hum behad khush hue lekin Allah janay kya hua ke woh rastay mein se hi laut gaye to is khauf se ke kahin Allah hum se naraz na ho gaya ho hum hazir hue hain isi tarah woh uzr-e-mazrat karte rahay Asr ki azan jab Hazrat Bilal ne di us waqt yeh aayat nazil hui, aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Waleed ki is khabar par abhi Huzoor ﷺ soch hi rahay thay ke kuch aadmi un ki taraf bhejein ke un ka wafd aa gaya aur unhon ne kaha Aap ka qasid aadhay rastay se hi laut gaya to hum ne khayal kiya ke Aap ne kisi narazgi ki bina par unhein wapsi ka hukum bhej diya hoga is liye hazir hue hain, hum Allah ke ghussay se aur Aap ki narazgi se Allah ki panah chahtay hain pas Allah Ta'ala ne yeh aayat utari aur us ka uzr sacha bataya. Aur riwayat mein hai ke qasid ne yeh bhi kaha tha ke in logon ne to Aap se larnay ke liye lashkar jama kar liya hai aur Islam se murtad ho gaye hain chunancha Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Khalid bin Waleed ki zer-e-imarat ek fauji dastay ko bhej diya lekin unhein farma diya tha ke pehle tehqeeq-o-taftish achi tarah kar lena jaldi se hamla na kar dena. Isi ke mutabiq Hazrat Khalid ne wahan pahunch kar apne jasoos shehar mein bhej diye woh khabar laye ke woh log Deen-e-Islam par qaim hain masjid mein azanein huin jinhein hum ne khud suna aur logon ko namaz parhtay hue khud dekha, subh hotay hi Hazrat Khalid khud gaye aur wahan ke Islami manzar se khush hue wapas aa kar Sarkar-e-Nabvi mein sari khabar di. Is par yeh aayat utri. Hazrat Qatada jo is waqiye ko bayan karte hain kehte hain ke Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke tehqeeq-o-talash bardbari aur door-beeni Allah ki taraf se hai.

Do mutaharib "Musalman jamaton" mein sulah karana har Musalman ka farz hai. Yahan hukm ho raha hai ke agar Musalmanon ki koi do jamatein ladne lag jayen to dusre Musalmanon ko chahiye ke un mein sulah kara dein. Aapas mein ladne wali jamaton ko Momin kehna, is se Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne istidlal kiya hai ke nafarmani go kitni hi badi ho, woh insaan ko imaan se alag nahin karti. Kharijiyon ka aur un ke muwafiq Mu'tazila ka mazhab is bare mein khilaf-e-haq hai. Isi aayat ki ta'eed is hadith se bhi hoti hai jo Sahih Bukhari waghera mein marwi hai ke ek martaba Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mimbar par khutba de rahe thay, aap ke sath mimbar par Hazrat Hasan bin Ali (R.A) bhi thay, aap kabhi un ki taraf dekhte kabhi logon ki taraf aur farmate ke mera yeh bacha sayyid hai aur is ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala Musalmanon ki do badi badi jamaton mein sulah kara de ga. Aap ki yeh peshgoi sachi nikli aur Ahl-e-Sham aur Ahl-e-Iraq mein badi lambi ladaiyon aur bade na-pasandida waqiyat ke baad aap ki wajah se sulah ho gayi. Phir irshad hota hai agar ek giroh dusre giroh par ziyadati kare to ziyadati karne wale se ladai ki jaye taake woh phir thikane aa jaye, haq ko sune aur maan le. Sahih hadith mein hai apne bhai ki madad kar, zalim ho to, mazloom ho to bhi. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne pucha ke mazloom hone ki halat mein to zahir hai lekin zalim hone ki halat mein kaise madad karun? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya use zulm se baaz rakho, yahi us ki us waqt yeh madad hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek martaba kaha gaya kya achha ho agar aap Abdullah bin Ubay ke yahan chaliye, chunancha aap apne gadhe par sawar hue aur Sahaba (R.A) aap ki ham-rikabi mein sath ho liye, zameen shor thi. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wahan pahunche to yeh kehne laga mujh se alag rahiye, Allah ki qasam aap ke gadhe ki badbu ne mera dimagh pareshan kar diya. Is par ek Ansari ne kaha Wallah Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke gadhe ki bu teri khushbu se bahut hi achhi hai. Is par idhar se udhar kuch log bol pade aur mamla badhne laga, balkay kuch hatha-pai aur joote chhariyan bhi kaam mein layi gayin. Un ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain Aus aur Khazraj qabail mein kuch chashmak ho gayi thi, un mein sulah kara dene ka is aayat mein hukm ho raha hai. Hazrat Suddi (R.H) farmate hain Imran nami ek Ansari thay, un ki biwi sahiba ka naam Um-e-Zaid tha, us ne apne maike jana chaha, khawand ne roka aur mana kar diya ke maike ka koi shakhs yahan bhi na aaye. Aurat ne yeh khabar apne maike kehwa di, woh log aaye aur use bala-khane se utar laye aur le jana chaha, un ke khawand ghar par thay nahin, khawand walon ne us ke chacha-zad bhaiyon ko ittila de kar unhein bula liya, ab khaincha-tani hone lagi aur un ke bare mein yeh aayat utri.

Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne dono taraf ke logon ko bula kar beech mein baith kar sulah kara di aur sab log mil gaye. Phir hukm hota hai dono fareeqon mein adl karo, Allah aadilon ko pasand farmata hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain duniya mein jo adl-o-insaf karte rahe woh motiyon ke mimbaron par Rahman Azza-wa-Jal ke samne honge aur yeh badla hoga unke adl-o-insaf ka (Nasa'i). Muslim ki hadith mein hai yeh log in mimbaron par Rahman Azza-wa-Jal ke dayin janib honge, yeh apne faislon mein, apne ahl-o-ayal mein aur jo kuch unke qabze mein hai us mein adl se kaam liya karte the. Phir farmaya kul momin deeni bhai hain. Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain musalman musalman ka bhai hai, use is par zulm-o-sitam na karna chahiye. Sahih hadith mein hai Allah Ta'ala bande ki madad karta rehta hai jab tak banda apne bhai ki madad mein laga rahe aur sahih hadith mein hai jab koi musalman apne ghair hazir bhai musalman ke liye uski pas-e-pusht dua karta hai to farishta kehta hai Aameen. Aur tujhe bhi Allah aisa hi de. Is bare mein aur bhi bahut si hadeeshein hain. Sahih hadith mein hai musalman sare ke sare apni mohabbat, raham-dili aur mel-jol mein misl ek jism ke hain, jab kisi uzw ko takleef ho to sara jism tadap uthta hai, kabhi bukhar chadh aata hai, kabhi shab-bedari ki takleef hoti hai. Ek aur hadith mein hai momin momin ke liye misl deewar ke hai jis ka ek hissa dusre hisse ko taqwiyat pahunchata aur mazboot karta hai, phir aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne apne ek hath ki ungliyan dusre hath ki ungliyon mein daal kar bataya. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai momin ka talluq aur ahl-e-iman se aisa hai jaise sar ka talluq jism se hai, momin ahl-e-iman ke liye wahi dard-mandi karta hai jo dard-mandi jism ko sar ke sath hai. Phir farmata hai dono ladne wali jamaton aur dono taraf ke islami bhaiyon mein sulah kara do, apne tamam kamon mein Allah ka dar rakho. Yehi woh ausaf hain jin ki wajah se Allah ki rahmat tum par nazil hogi, parhezgaron ke sath hi Rab ka raham rehta hai.

Do mutaharib "Musalman jamaton" mein sulah karana har Musalman ka farz hai. Yahan hukm ho raha hai ke agar Musalmanon ki koi do jamatein ladne lag jayen to dusre Musalmanon ko chahiye ke un mein sulah kara dein. Aapas mein ladne wali jamaton ko Momin kehna, is se Hazrat Imam Bukhari (R.H) ne istidlal kiya hai ke nafarmani go kitni hi badi ho, woh insaan ko imaan se alag nahin karti. Kharijiyon ka aur un ke muwafiq Mu'tazila ka mazhab is bare mein khilaf-e-haq hai. Isi aayat ki ta'eed is hadith se bhi hoti hai jo Sahih Bukhari waghera mein marwi hai ke ek martaba Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mimbar par khutba de rahe thay, aap ke sath mimbar par Hazrat Hasan bin Ali (R.A) bhi thay, aap kabhi un ki taraf dekhte kabhi logon ki taraf aur farmate ke mera yeh bacha sayyid hai aur is ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala Musalmanon ki do badi badi jamaton mein sulah kara de ga. Aap ki yeh peshgoi sachi nikli aur Ahl-e-Sham aur Ahl-e-Iraq mein badi lambi ladaiyon aur bade na-pasandida waqiyat ke baad aap ki wajah se sulah ho gayi. Phir irshad hota hai agar ek giroh dusre giroh par ziyadati kare to ziyadati karne wale se ladai ki jaye taake woh phir thikane aa jaye, haq ko sune aur maan le. Sahih hadith mein hai apne bhai ki madad kar, zalim ho to, mazloom ho to bhi. Hazrat Anas (R.A) ne pucha ke mazloom hone ki halat mein to zahir hai lekin zalim hone ki halat mein kaise madad karun? Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya use zulm se baaz rakho, yahi us ki us waqt yeh madad hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ek martaba kaha gaya kya achha ho agar aap Abdullah bin Ubay ke yahan chaliye, chunancha aap apne gadhe par sawar hue aur Sahaba (R.A) aap ki ham-rikabi mein sath ho liye, zameen shor thi. Jab Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) wahan pahunche to yeh kehne laga mujh se alag rahiye, Allah ki qasam aap ke gadhe ki badbu ne mera dimagh pareshan kar diya. Is par ek Ansari ne kaha Wallah Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke gadhe ki bu teri khushbu se bahut hi achhi hai. Is par idhar se udhar kuch log bol pade aur mamla badhne laga, balkay kuch hatha-pai aur joote chhariyan bhi kaam mein layi gayin. Un ke bare mein yeh aayat utri hai. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain Aus aur Khazraj qabail mein kuch chashmak ho gayi thi, un mein sulah kara dene ka is aayat mein hukm ho raha hai. Hazrat Suddi (R.H) farmate hain Imran nami ek Ansari thay, un ki biwi sahiba ka naam Um-e-Zaid tha, us ne apne maike jana chaha, khawand ne roka aur mana kar diya ke maike ka koi shakhs yahan bhi na aaye. Aurat ne yeh khabar apne maike kehwa di, woh log aaye aur use bala-khane se utar laye aur le jana chaha, un ke khawand ghar par thay nahin, khawand walon ne us ke chacha-zad bhaiyon ko ittila de kar unhein bula liya, ab khaincha-tani hone lagi aur un ke bare mein yeh aayat utri.

Har ta'ana baaz aib-jo mujrim hai. Allah Tabarak-o-Ta'ala logon ko haqeer-o-zaleel karne aur un ka mazaq urane se rok raha hai. Hadith-e-Shareef mein hai, "Takabbur haq se munh mor lene aur logon ko zaleel-o-khwar samajhne ka naam hai." Is ki wajah Quran-e-Kareem ne yeh bayan farmayi ke jise tum zaleel kar rahe ho, jis ka tum mazaq ura rahe ho, mumkin hai ke Allah ke nazdeek woh tum se zyada ba-waqat ho. Mardon ko mana kar ke phir khastan aurton ko bhi is se roka aur is mal'oon khaslat ko haram qarar diya. Chunancha Quran-e-Kareem ka irshad hai, Ayat: (Wailul-likulli humazatil-lumazah) (Surah (Al-Humazah: 1), yani har ta'ana baaz aib-jo ke liye kharabi hai. Humaz fe'l se hota hai aur lumaz qaul se. Ek aur ayat mein hai (Hammaazim-mashsha'im-bi-nameem) al-kh, yani woh jo logon ko haqeer ginta ho, un par charha chala ja raha ho aur lagane bujhane wala ho. Garaz in tamam kamon ko hamari shariyat ne haram qarar diya.

Yahan lafz toh yeh hain ke apne aap ko aib na lagao, matlab yeh hai ke aapas mein ek dusre ko aib na lagao, jaise farmaya, Ayat: (Wala taqtulu anfusakum innallaha kana bikum raheema) (Surah (An-Nisa: 29), yani ek dusre ko qatl na karo. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas (R.A), Mujahid (R.H), Saeed bin Jubair (R.H), Qatadah (R.H), Muqatil bin Hayyan (R.H) farmate hain is ka matlab yeh hai ke ek dusre ko ta'ane na do. Phir farmaya kisi ko churao mat! Jis laqab se woh naraz hota ho, us laqab se use na pukaro, na us ko bura naam do. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke yeh hukm Banu Salmah ke bare mein nazil hua hai. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) jab Madine mein aaye toh yahan har shakhs ke do-do teen-teen naam thay. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) un mein se kisi ko kisi naam se pukarte toh log kehte, "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Yeh is se chirta hai." Is par yeh ayat utri (Abu Dawood). Phir farman hai ke imaan ki halat mein fasiqana alqab se aapas mein ek dusre ko namzad karna nihayat buri baat hai. Ab tumhein is se tauba karni chahiye warna zalim gine jaoge.))

Dehshat gard aur haras phailane wale napasandida log. Allah Ta'ala apne momin bandon ko badgumani karne, tohmat rakhne, apnon aur ghairon ko khaufzada karne, khwah-makhwah ki dehshat dil mein rakh lene se rokta hai aur farmata hai ke basa-auqat aksar is qisam ke guman bilkul gunah hote hain, pas tumhein is mein poori ehtiyat chahiye. Amir-ul-Momineen Hazrat Umar bin Khattab R.A se marwi hai ke aap ne farmaya tere musalman bhai ki zaban se jo kalma nikla ho jahan tak tujh se ho sake use bhalai aur achhai par mahmool kar. Ibn-e-Majah mein hai ke Nabi ﷺ ne tawaf-e-Ka'aba karte hue farmaya tu kitna pak ghar hai? Tu kaisi badi hurmat wala hai? Is ki qasam jis ke hath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai ke momin ki hurmat us ke maal aur us ki jaan ki hurmat aur us ke sath nek guman karne ki hurmat Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek teri hurmat se bahut badi hai. Yeh hadith sirf Ibn-e-Majah mein hi hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain badgumani se bacho, guman sab se badi jhooti baat hai, bhed na tatolo. Ek dusre ki toh hasil karne ki koshish mein na lag jaya karo, hasad, bughz aur ek dusre se munh phailane se bacho, sab mil kar Allah ke bande aur aapas mein bhai-bhai ban kar raho saho. Muslim waghera mein hai ek dusre se rooth kar na baith jaya karo, ek dusre se mel-jol tark na kar liya karo, ek dusre ka hasad bughz na kiya karo balkeh sab mil kar Allah ke bande aapas mein dusre ke bhai-band ho kar zindagi guzaro. Kisi musalman ko halal nahin ke apne dusre musalman bhai se teen din se zyada bol-chal aur mel-jol chhod de. Tabrani mein hai ke teen khaslatein meri ummat mein reh jayengi: faal lena, hasad karna aur badgumani karna. Ek shakhs ne pucha Huzoor ﷺ phir in ka tadaruk kya hai? Farmaya jab hasad kare to istighfar kar le. Jab guman paida ho to use chhod de aur yaqeen na kar aur jab shagoon le khwah nek nikle khwah bad apne kaam se na ruk use poora kar. Abu Dawood mein hai ke ek shakhs ko Hazrat Ibn-e-Masood R.A ke paas laya gaya aur kaha gaya ke is ki darhi se sharab ke qatre gir rahe hain, aap ne farmaya hamein bhed tatolne se mana farmaya gaya hai, agar hamare samne koi cheez zahir ho gayi to hum us par pakad sakte hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Uqba ke katib Wajeen ke paas gaye, Hazrat Uqba R.A gaye aur un se kaha ke mere pados mein kuch log sharabi hain, mera irada hai ke main darogha ko bula kar unhein giraftar kara doon, aap ne farmaya aisa na karna balkeh unhein samjhao bujhao, dant-dapat kar do, phir kuch dinon ke baad aaye aur kaha woh baaz nahin aate ab to main zaroor darogha ko bulaunga, aap ne farmaya afsos afsos tum hargiz hargiz aisa na karo, suno main ne Rasool Allah ﷺ se suna hai, aap ne farmaya jo shakhs kisi musalman ki parda-dari kare use itna sawab milega jaise kisi ne zinda dargor karda ladki ko bacha liya.

Abu Dawood mein hai Hazrat Muawiyah R.A farmate hain Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya hai agar tu logon ke batin aur un ke raaz tatolne ke darpay hoga to tu unhein bigaar de ga ya farmaya mumkin hai tu unhein kharab kar de. Hazrat Abu Darda R.A farmate hain is hadith se Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Muawiyah R.A ko bahut faida pahunchaya. Abu Dawood ki aik aur hadith mein hai ke ameer aur badshah jab apne mat-haton aur ri'aya ki buraiyan tatolne lag jata hai aur gehra utarna shuru kar deta hai to unhein bigaar deta hai. Phir farmaya ke tajassus na karo yani buraiyan maloom karne ki koshish na karo taak jhaank na kiya karo isi se jasoos maakhuz hai. Tajassus ka itlaq umooman burai par hota hai aur tahassus ka itlaq bhalai dhoondne par. Jaise Hazrat Yaqub A.S apne beton se farmate hain (Ya bani-yazhabu fatahassasu min Yusufa wa akhihi wa la tai-yasu mir rawhillahi innahu la yai-yasu mir rawhillahi illal qawmul kafirun) (Surah (Yusuf: 87), bachon tum jao aur Yusuf ko dhoondo aur Allah ki rahmat se na-umeed na ho aur kabhi kabhi in dono ka istemal shar aur burai mein bhi hota hai chunancha hadith-e-sharif mein hai na tajassus karo na tahassus karo na hasad-o-bughz karo na munh moro balkay sab mil kar Allah ke banday bhai bhai ban jao. Imam Auza'i R.H farmate hain tajassus kehte hain kisi cheez mein kureid karne ko aur tahassus kehte hain un logon ki sargoshi par kaan lagane ko jo kisi ko apni baatein sunana na chahte hon. Aur tadabur kehte hain aik dusre se ruk kar azurda ho kar qata-e-taluqat karne ko. Phir ghibat se mana farmata hai. Abu Dawood mein hai logon ne poocha Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ ghibat kya hai? Farmaya yeh ke tu apne musalman bhai ki kisi aisi baat ka zikr kare jo use buri maloom ho to kaha gaya agar woh burai us mein ho jab bhi? Farmaya haan ghibat to yahi hai warna bohtan aur tohmat hai. Abu Dawood mein hai aik martaba Hazrat Aisha R.A ne farmaya ke Safiyah to aisi aisi hain, Musaddad rawi kehte hain yani kam qamat, to Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tu ne aisi baat kahi hai ke samundar ke pani mein agar mila di jaye to use bhi bigaar de aur aik martaba aap ke samne kisi shakhs ki kuch aisi hi baatein bayan ki gayin to aap ne farmaya main ise pasand nahin karta mujhe chahe aisa karne mein koi bahut bara nafa hi milta ho. Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke aik bibi sahiba Hazrat Aisha R.A ke yahan aayin jab woh jaane lagin to Siddiqa R.A ne Huzoor ﷺ ko ishare se kaha ke yeh bahut past qamat hain, Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tum ne in ki ghibat ki. Al-gharaz ghibat haram hai aur is ki hurmat par musalmanon ka ijma hai. Lekin haan shar'i maslahat ki bina par kisi ki aisi baat ka zikr karna ghibat mein dakhil nahin jaise jarh-o-ta'deel, nasihat-o-khair khwahi jaise ke Nabi ﷺ ne aik fajir shakhs ki nisbat farmaya tha yeh bahut bura aadmi hai aur jaise ke Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya tha Muawiyah muflis shakhs hai aur Abu Jahm bara maarne peetne wala aadmi hai.

Yeh aap ne us waqt farmaya tha jabke un dono buzurgon ne Hazrat Fatima bint-e-Qais se nikah ka manga dala tha aur bhi jo baatein is tarah ki hon un ki toh ijazat hai baqi aur ghibat haram hai aur kabira gunah hai. Isi liye yahan farmaya ke jis tarah tum apne murda bhai ka gosht khane se ghinn karte ho is se bahut zyada nafrat tumhein ghibat se karni chahiye. Jaise hadith mein hai apne diye hue hiba ko wapas lene wala aisa hai jaise kutta jo qai kar ke chaat leta hai aur farmaya buri misaal hamare liye laiq nahin. Hujjat-ul-Wida ke khutbe mein hai tumhare khoon maal aabru tum par aise hi haram hain jaisi hurmat tumhare is din ki tumhare is mahine mein aur tumhare is shehar mein hai. Abu Dawood mein Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ka farman hai ke musalman ka maal us ki izzat aur us ka khoon musalman par haram hai insaan ko utni hi burai kafi hai ke woh apne dusre musalman bhai ki haqarat kare. Aur hadith mein hai ae woh logo jin ki zabaanein toh iman la chuki hain lekin dil imandar nahin hue tum musalmanon ki ghibatein karna chhod do aur un ke aibon ki kured na kiya karo yaad rakho agar tum ne un ke aib tatole toh Allah Ta'ala tumhari poshida kharabiyon ko zahir kar de ga yahan tak ke tum apne gharane walon mein bhi badnaam aur ruswa ho jao ge, Musnad Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne hamein ek khutba sunaya jis mein aap ne parda nasheen aurton ke kanon mein bhi apni awaz pahunchai aur is khutbe mein upar wali hadith bayan farmai, Hazrat Ibn-e-Umar (R.A) ne ek martaba Ka'aba ki taraf dekha aur farmaya teri hurmat-o-azmat ka kya hi kehna hai lekin tujh se bhi bahut zyada hurmat ek imandar shakhs ki Allah ke nazdeek hai. Abu Dawood mein hai jis ne kisi musalman ki burai kar ke ek niwala hasil kiya use jahannam ki utni hi ghiza khilai jaye gi isi tarah jis ne musalmanon ki burai karne par poshak hasil ki use isi jaisi poshak jahannam ki pehnai jaye gi aur jo shakhs kisi dusre ki badai dikhane sunane ko khada hua use Allah Ta'ala Qayamat ke din dikhawe sunawe ke maqam mein khada kar de ga. Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain Me'raj wali raat mein ne dekha ke kuch logon ke nakhun tanbe ke hain jin se woh apne chehre aur seene noch rahe hain mein ne pucha ke Jibraeel (A.S) yeh kaun log hain? Farmaya yeh woh hain jo logon ke gosht khate the aur un ki izzatein loot-te the (Abu Dawood) aur riwayat mein hai ke logon ke sawal ke jawab mein aap ne farmaya Me'raj wali raat mein ne bahut se logon ko dekha jin mein mard-o-aurat dono the ke farishte un ke pehluon se gosht kaat-te hain aur phir unhein is ke khane par majboor kar rahe hain aur woh ise chaba rahe hain mere sawal par kaha gaya ke yeh woh log hain jo ta'ana zan, ghibat go, chughal khor the, unhein jabran aaj khud un ka gosht khilaya ja raha hai (Ibn-e-Abi Hatim) yeh hadith bahut mutawwal hai aur hum ne puri hadith Surah Subhan ki tafsir mein bayan bhi kar di hai falhamdulillah.

Musnad-e-Abu Dawood Tayalisi mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne logon ko rozay ka hukum diya aur farmaya jab tak main na kahoon koi iftar na kare. Shaam ko log aanay lagay aur aap se daryaft karne lagay, aap unhein ijazat detay aur woh iftar karte. Itnay mein ek sahib aaye aur arz kiya, "Huzoor ﷺ! Do aurton ne roza rakha tha jo aap hi ke muta'alliqeen mein se hain, unhein bhi aap ijazat dijiye ke roza khol lein." Aap ne us se munh pher liya. Us ne dobara arz ki to aap ne farmaya, "Woh rozay se nahin hain, kya woh bhi rozay-dar ho sakta hai? Jo insani gosht khaye. Jao unhein kaho ke agar woh rozay se hain to qay karein." Chunancha unhon ne qay ki jis mein khoon jamay ke lothray niklay. Us ne aakar Huzoor ﷺ ko khabar di, aap ne farmaya, "Agar yeh isi halat mein mar jatin to aag ka luqma bantin." Is ki sanad za'eef hai aur matan bhi ghareeb hai.

Dusri riwayat mein hai ke us shakhs ne kaha tha, "Huzoor ﷺ! Un dono aurton ki rozay mein buri halat hai, maaray piyas ke mar rahi hain," aur yeh dopahar ka waqt tha. Huzoor ﷺ ki khamoshi par us ne dobara kaha ke, "Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Woh to mar gayi hongi ya thori der mein mar jayengi." Aap ne farmaya, "Jao unhein bula lao." Jab woh aayin to aap ne doodh ka matka ek ke samnay rakh kar farmaya, "Is mein qay kar." Us ne qay ki to us mein peep, khoon-e-jamid waghera nikli jis se aadha matka bhar gaya. Phir dusri se qay karayi, us mein bhi yahi cheezein aur gosht ke lothray waghera niklay aur matka bhar gaya. Is waqt aap ne farmaya, "Inhein dekho, halal roza rakhay huay thin aur haram kha rahi thin, dono baith kar logon ke gosht khanay lagi thin (yani gheebat kar rahi thin)." (Musnad-e-Ahmad)

Musnad-e-Hafiz Abu Ya'la mein hai ke Hazrat Ma'iz (R.A) Rasool Allah ﷺ ke paas aaye aur kaha, "Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Main ne zina kiya hai." Aap ne munh pher liya yahan tak ke woh chaar martaba keh chukay, phir paanchwin dafa aap ne kaha, "Tu ne zina kiya hai?" Jawab diya, "Haan." Farmaya, "Janta hai zina kisay kehtay hain?" Jawab diya, "Haan, jis tarah insan apni halal aurat ke paas jata hai isi tarah main ne haram aurat se kiya." Aap ne farmaya, "Ab tera maqsad kya hai?" Kaha, "Yeh ke aap mujhe is gunah se paak karein." Aap ne farmaya, "Kya tu ne isi tarah dukhool kiya tha jis tarah silai surma-dani mein aur lakri kuwein mein?" Kaha, "Haan Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ!" Ab aap ne unhein rajam karne yani pathrao karne ka hukum diya, chunancha yeh rajam kar diye gaye. Is ke baad Huzoor ﷺ ne do shakhson ko yeh kehtay huay suna ke, "Isay dekho, Allah ne is ki parda-poshi ki thi lekin is ne apnay tayin na chora yahan tak ke kuttay ki tarah pathrao kiya gaya." Aap yeh suntay huay chaltay rahay. Thori der baad aap ne dekha ke rastay mein ek murda gadha para hua hai. Farmaya, "Falan falan shakhs kahan hain?" Woh sawari se utrein aur is gadhay ka gosht khayein. Unhon ne kaha, "Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Allah Ta'ala aap ko bakhshay, kya yeh khanay ke qabil hai?" Aap ne farmaya, "Abhi jo tum ne apnay bhai ki badi bayan ki thi woh is se bhi zyada buri cheez thi."

Us Allah ki qasam jis ke haath mein meri jaan hai, woh shakhs jise tum ne bura kaha tha, woh toh ab is waqt Jannat ki nehron mein ghote laga raha hai. Is ki asnaad sahih hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai, hum Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke saath thay ke nihayat sari hui murdari bu wali hawa chali, Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Jaante ho? Yeh bu kis cheez ki hai? Yeh badbu un ki hai jo logon ki gheebat karte hain." Aur riwayat mein hai ke munafiqon ke ek garoh ne musalmanon ki gheebat ki hai, yeh badbudar hawa woh hai. Hazrat Suddi farmate hain ke Hazrat Salman (R.A) ek safar mein do shakhson ke saath thay jin ki yeh khidmat karte thay aur woh unhein khana khilate thay. Ek martaba Hazrat Salman (R.A) so gaye thay aur qafila aage chal pada. Parao dalne ke baad un dono ne dekha ke Hazrat Salman (R.A) nahin, toh apne hathon se unhein khaima khada karna pada aur gusse se kaha, "Salman toh bas itne hi kaam ka hai ke paki pakai kha le aur tayyar khaime mein aa kar aaram kar le." Thodi der baad Hazrat Salman (R.A) pahunche, un dono ke paas saalan na tha toh kaha, "Tum jao aur Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se hamare liye saalan le aao." Yeh gaye aur Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha, "Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Mujhe mere dono sathiyon ne bheja hai ke agar aap ke paas saalan ho toh de dijiye." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Woh saalan ka kya karenge? Unhon ne toh saalan pa liya." Hazrat Salman (R.A) wapas gaye aur ja kar un se yeh baat kahi. Woh uthe aur khud hazir-e-Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hue aur kaha, "Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam)! Hamare paas toh saalan nahin, na aap ne bheja." Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Tum ne musalman ke gosht ka saalan kha liya jabke tum ne unhein yun kaha." Is par yeh aayat nazil hui (Maitan), is liye ke woh soye hue thay aur yeh un ki gheebat kar rahe thay. Mukhtar Abu Ziya mein taqreeban aisa hi waqea Hazrat Abu Bakr (R.A) aur Hazrat Umar (R.A) ka hai, is mein yeh bhi hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya, "Main tumhare is khadim ka gosht tumhare danton mein atka hua dekh raha hoon," aur un ka apne ghulam se jabke woh soya hua tha aur un ka khana tayyar nahin kiya tha, sirf itna hi kehna marwi hai ke "Yeh toh bada sone wala hai." In dono buzurgon ne Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se kaha, "Aap hamare liye istighfar karein." Abu Ya'la mein hai, "Jis ne duniya mein apne bhai ka gosht khaya (yani is ki gheebat ki), Qayamat ke din is ke samne woh gosht laya jayega aur kaha jayega ke jaise is ki zindagi mein tu ne is ka gosht khaya tha, ab is murde ka gosht bhi kha." Ab yeh cheekhe ga, chillaye ga, haye waye kare ga aur ise jabran woh murda gosht khana padega. Yeh riwayat bahut ghareeb hai. Phir farmata hai, Allah ka lihaz karo, is ke ahkaam baja lao, is ki mana karda cheezon se ruk jao aur is se darte raha karo. Jo is ki taraf jhuke woh is ki taraf mail ho jata hai, tauba karne wale ki tauba qabool farmata hai aur jo is par bharosa kare, is ki taraf ruju kare, woh is par raham aur meharbani farmata hai. Jamhoor ulama-e-kiram farmate hain, gheebat go ki tauba ka tareeqa yeh hai ke woh is khaslat ko chhod de aur phir se is gunah ko na kare. Pehle jo kar chuka hai is par nadim hona bhi shart hai ya nahin?

Is mein ikhtilaf hai aur jis ki ghibat ki hai us se ma'afi hasil kar le. Ba'az kehte hain yeh bhi shart nahin is liye ke mumkin hai use khabar hi na ho aur ma'afi mangne ko jab jayega to use aur ranj hoga. Pas is ka behtareen tariqa yeh hai ke jin majlison mein us ki burai bayan ki thi un mein ab us ki sachi safai bayan kare aur is burai ko apni taqat ke mutabiq dafa kar de to awwalan badla ho jayega. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai jo shakhs us waqt kisi momin ki himayat kare jabke koi munafiq us ki muzammat bayan kar raha ho Allah Ta'ala ek farishtay ko muqarrar kar deta hai jo Qayamat walay din us ke gosht ko naar-e-Jahannam se bachayega aur jo shakhs kisi momin par koi aisi baat kahega jis se us ka irada use mat'oon karne ka ho use Allah Ta'ala Pul-e-Sirat par rok le ga yahan tak ke badla ho jaye. Yeh hadith Abu Dawood mein bhi hai. Abu Dawood ki ek aur hadith mein hai jo shakhs kisi musalman ki be-izzati aisi jagah mein kare jahan us ki aabroo rezi aur tauheen hoti ho to use bhi Allah Ta'ala aisi jagah ruswa kare ga jahan woh apni madad ka talib ho aur jo musalman aisi jagah apne bhai ki himayat kare Allah Ta'ala bhi aisi jagah us ki nusrat kare ga (Abu Dawood).)

Nasl-e-Insani ka nuqta-e-aaghaz Allah Ta'ala bayan farmata hai ke usne tamam insano ko ek hi nafs se paida kiya hai yani Hazrat Adam A.S se, unhi se unki biwi sahiba Hazrat Hawa ko paida kiya tha aur phir un dono se nasl-e-insani phaili. Shuoob qabail se aam hai, misaal ke taur par Arab to shuoob mein dakhil hain, phir Quraish, ghair Quraish, phir unki taqseem mein yeh sab qabail dakhil hain. Baaz kehte hain shuoob se murad Ajami log aur qabail se murad Arab jamatein. Jaise ke Bani Israel ko Asbaat kaha gaya hai, maine un tamam baaton ko ek alaihda muqaddama mein likh diya hai jise maine Abu Umar bin Abdullah ki kitab 'Al-Anbah' aur 'Kitab-ul-Qasd wal-Umam fi Ma'rifat-e-Ansab-il-Arab wal-Ajam' se jama kiya hai. Maqsad is aayat-e-mubaraka ka yeh hai ke Hazrat Adam A.S jo mitti se paida hue the, unki taraf se nisbat mein kul jahan ke aadmi hum-martaba hain. Ab jo kuch fazeelat jis kisi ko hasil hogi woh amr-e-deeni, ita'at-e-Allah aur itteba-e-Nabvi ki wajah se hogi. Yehi raaz hai jo is aayat ko gheebat ki muman'at aur ek dusre ki tauheen-o-tazleel se rokne ke baad warid ki, ke sab log apni paidaishi nisbat ke lihaz se bilkul yaksan hain. Kunbay, qabeelay, baradariyan aur jamatein sirf pehchan ke liye hain taake jatha-bandi aur hamdardi qaim rahe. Fulan bin fulan qabeelay wala kaha ja sake aur is tarah ek dusre ki pehchan aasaan ho jaye, warna bashariyat ke aitbar se sab qaumein yaksan hain. Hazrat Sufyan Sauri R.H farmate hain qabeela Humair apne halifiyon ki taraf mansoob hota tha aur Hijazi Arab apne qabeelon ki taraf apni nisbat karte the. Tirmidhi mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain nasab ka ilm hasil karo taake sila-e-rehmi kar sako, sila-e-rehmi se log tum se mohabbat karne lagenge, tumhare maal aur tumhari zindagi mein Allah barkat dega. Yeh hadith is sanad se ghareeb hai. Phir farmaya hasab-nasab Allah ke haan nahin chalta, wahan to fazeelat, taqwa aur parhezgari se milti hai. Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ se daryaft kiya gaya ke sab se zyada buzurg kaun hai? Aap ﷺ ne farmaya jo sab se zyada parhezgar ho. Logon ne kaha hum yeh aam baat nahin poochte, farmaya phir sab se zyada buzurg Hazrat Yusuf A.S hain jo khud Nabi the, Nabi-zaday the, dada bhi Nabi the, pardada to Khalilullah the. Unhone kaha hum yeh bhi nahin poochte. Farmaya phir Arab ke bare mein poochte ho? Suno! Unke jo log jahiliyat ke zamane mein mumtaz the wohi ab Islam mein bhi pasandida hain jabke woh ilm-e-deen ki samajh hasil kar lein. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai Allah tumhari suraton aur maalon ko nahin dekhta balkay tumhare dilon aur amalon ko dekhta hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ne Hazrat Abu Zar R.A se farmaya khayal rakh ke tu kisi surkh-o-siyah par koi fazeelat nahin rakhta, haan taqwa mein barh ja to fazeelat hai. Tabrani mein hai Musalman sab aapas mein bhai hain, kisi ko kisi par koi fazeelat nahin magar taqwa ke sath.

Musnad-e-Bazzar mein hai tum sab aulad-e-Adam ho aur khud Hazrat Adam mitti se paida kiye gaye hain. Logo apne baap dadon ke naam par fakhr karne se baaz aao warna Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek ret ke todon aur aabi parindon se bhi zyada halke ho jaoge. Ibn-e-Abi Hatim mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Fatah-e-Makkah wale din apni oontni Qaswa par sawaar ho kar tawaf kiya aur arkaan ko aap apni chhari se chhoo lete the. Phir chunke masjid mein uske bithane ko jagah na mili to logon ne aap ko hathon hath utara aur oontni batn-e-maseel mein le ja kar bithaya. Iske baad aap ne apni oontni par sawaar ho kar logon ko khutba sunaya jisme Allah Ta'ala ki poori hamd-o-sana bayan kar ke farmaya: Logo Allah Ta'ala ne tum se jahiliyat ke asbaab aur jahiliyat ke baap dadon par fakhr karne ki rasm ab door kar di hai, pas insaan do hi qisam ke hain ya to nek parhezgar jo Allah ke nazdeek buland martaba hain ya badkar ghair muttaqi jo Allah ki nigahon mein zaleel-o-khwar hain. Phir aap ne yeh aayat tilawat farmayi. Phir farmaya main apni yeh baat kehta hoon aur Allah Ta'ala se apne liye aur tumhare liye istighfar karta hoon. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke tumhare nasab naame darasal koi kaam dene wale nahin, tum sab bilkul barabar ke Hazrat Adam ke ladke ho, kisi ko kisi par fazeelat nahin, haan fazeelat deen-o-taqwa se hai. Insaan ko yahi burai kaafi hai ke woh badgo, bakheel, aur fahash kalam ho. Ibn-e-Jareer ki is riwayat mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala tumhare hasab nasab ko Qayamat ke din na poochhega, tum sab mein se zyada buzurg Allah ke nazdeek woh hain jo tum sab se zyada parhezgar hon. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai ke Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) mimbar par the ke ek shakhs ne sawal kiya ke Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) sab se behtar kaun hai? Aap ne farmaya jo sab se zyada mehman nawaz, sab se zyada parhezgar, sab se zyada achhi baat ka hukm dene wala, sab se zyada buri baat se rokne wala, sab se zyada sila-rehmi karne wala hai. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko duniya ki koi cheez ya koi shakhs kabhi bhala nahin lagta tha magar taqwe wale insaan ke. Allah tumhein jaanta hai aur tumhare kaamon se bhi khabardar hai, hidayat ke laiq jo hain unhein raah-e-raast dikhata hai aur jo is laiq nahin woh be-raah ho rahe hain. Reham aur azaab uski mashiyat par mauqoof hain, fazeelat uske haath hai jise chahe jis par chahe buzurgi ata farmaye, yeh tamam umoor uske ilm aur uski khabar par mabni hain. Is aayat-e-karima aur in ahadees-e-sharifa se istidlal kar ke ulama ne farmaya hai ke nikah mein qaumiyat aur hasab nasab ki shart nahin, siwaye deen ke aur koi shart motabar nahin. Dusron ne kaha hai ke hum nasbi aur qaumiyat bhi shart hai aur unke dalail inke siwa aur hain jo kutub-e-fiqh mein mazkoor hain aur hum bhi unhein Kitab-ul-Ahkaam mein zikr kar chuke hain, falhamdulillah.

Tabrani mein Hazrat Abdur-Rahman se marwi hai ke unhon ne Banu Hashim mein se ek shakhs ko yeh kehte hue suna ke main Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se ba-nisbat aur tamam logon ke bahut zyada qareeb hoon, pas farmaya tere siwa main bhi bahut zyada qareeb hoon un se ba-nisbat tere jo tujhe Aap (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se nisbat hai.

Iman ka da'wa karne wale apna jaiza toh lein. Kuch a'rabi log Islam mein dakhil hote hi apne iman ka barha charha kar da'wa karne lagte the halankeh darasal unke dilon mein ab tak iman ki jarein mazboot nahin hui thin. Unko Allah Ta'ala is da'we se rokta hai. Yeh kehte the hum iman laye. Allah apne Nabi ko hukum deta hai keh inko kahiye ab tak iman tumhare dilon mein dakhil nahin hua, tum yun na kaho keh hum iman laye balkeh yun kaho keh hum Musalman hue yani Islam ke halqa-ba-gosh hue, Nabi ki ita'at mein aaye hain. Is ayat ne yeh faida diya keh iman Islam se makhsoos cheez hai jaise keh Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at ka mazhab hai. Jibraeel A.S wali hadith bhi isi par dalalat karti hai jabkeh unhon ne Islam ke bare mein sawal kiya, phir iman ke bare mein, phir ehsan ke bare mein. Pas woh zeena-ba-zeena charhte gaye, aam se khas ki taraf aaye aur phir khas se akhass ki taraf aaye. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai keh Huzoor ﷺ ne chand logon ko atiya aur inaam diya aur ek shakhs ko kuch bhi na diya. Is par Hazrat Sa'ad R.A ne farmaya Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ aap ne falan falan ko diya aur falan ko bilkul chor diya halankeh woh momin hai. Huzoor ﷺ ne farmaya Musalman? Teen martaba yak-e-baad-e-deegare Hazrat Sa'ad R.A ne yahi kaha aur Huzoor ﷺ ne bhi yahi jawab diya. Phir farmaya ae Sa'ad! Main logon ko deta hoon aur jo in mein mujhe bahut zyada mehboob hota hai use nahin deta hoon, deta hoon is dar se keh kahin woh oundhe munh aag mein na gir parein. Yeh hadith Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi hai. Pas is hadith mein bhi Huzoor ﷺ ne momin-o-muslim mein farq kiya aur maloom ho gaya keh iman zyada khas hai ba-nisbat Islam ke. Hum ne ise ma'a dalail Sahih Bukhari ki Kitab-ul-Iman ki sharah mein zikr kar diya hai, falhamdulillah. Aur is hadith mein is baat par bhi dalalat hai keh yeh shakhs Musalman the, munafiq na the, is liye keh aap ne unhein koi atiya ata nahin farmaya aur use uske Islam ke supurd kar diya. Pas maloom hua keh yeh a'rab jin ka zikr is ayat mein hai munafiq na the, the toh Musalman lekin ab tak unke dilon mein iman sahih taur par mustahkam na hua tha aur unhon ne is buland maqam tak apni rasai ho jane ka abhi se da'wa kar diya tha is liye unhein adab sikhaya gaya. Hazrat Ibn-e-Abbas R.A aur Ibrahim Nakh'i R.H aur Qatada R.H ke qaul ka yahi matlab hai aur isi ko Imam Ibn-e-Jareer R.H ne ikhtiyar kiya hai. Hamein yeh sab yun kehna para keh Hazrat Imam Bukhari R.H farmate hain keh yeh log munafiq the jo iman zahir karte the lekin darasal momin na the (yeh yaad rahe iman-o-Islam mein farq us waqt hai jabkeh Islam apni haqeeqat par na ho, jab Islam haqeeqi ho toh wahi Islam iman hai aur us waqt iman-o-Islam mein koi farq nahin, is ke bahut se qawi dalail Imam-ul-Aimma Hazrat Imam Bukhari R.H ne apni kitab Sahih Bukhari mein Kitab-ul-Iman mein bayan farmaye hain aur in logon ka munafiq hona is ka suboot bhi majood hai, Wallahu A'lam).

(Mutarjim) Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair, Hazrat Mujahid, Hazrat Ibn-e-Zaid farmate hain yeh jo Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke balkeh tum (Aslamna) kaho is se murad yeh hai ke hum qatl aur qaid-o-band hone se bachne ke liye tabe ho gaye hain, Hazrat Mujahid farmate hain ke yeh aayat Banu Asad bin Khuzaima ke bare mein nazil hui hai. Hazrat Qatada farmate hain ke un logon ke bare mein utri hai jo imaan lane ka dawa karte thay halankeh ab tak wahan pohanche na thay pas unhein adab sikhaya gaya aur bataya gaya ke yeh ab tak imaan tak nahin pohanche agar yeh munafiq hote toh unhein daant dapt ki jaati aur un ki ruswai ki jaati jaise ke Surah Baraat mein munafiqon ka zikr kiya gaya lekin yahan toh unhein sirf adab sikhaya gaya. Phir farmata hai agar tum Allah aur usi ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke farman-bardar rahoge toh tumhare kisi amal ka ajar mara na jayega. Jaise farmaya aayat (Wama alatnahum min amalihim min shai'in kullumri'in bima kasaba raheen) (At-Tur: 21) hum ne un ke aamal mein se kuch bhi nahin ghataya. Phir farmaya jo Allah ki taraf ruju kare burai se laut aaye Allah us ke gunah maaf farmane wala aur us ki taraf raham bhari nigahon se dekhne wala hai phir farmata hai ke kamil imaan wale sirf woh log hain jo Allah par aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par dil se yaqeen rakhte hain phir na shak karte hain na kabhi un ke dil mein koi nikamma khayal paida hota hai balkeh isi khayal-e-tasdeeq par aur kamil yaqeen par jam jaate hain aur jame hi rehte hain aur apne nafs aur dil ki pasandida daulat ko balkeh apni jaano ko bhi rah-e-Allah ke jihad mein kharch karte hain. Yeh sache log hain yani yeh hain jo keh sakte hain ke hum imaan laye hain yeh un logon ki tarah nahin jo sirf zaban se hi imaan ka dawa kar ke reh jaate hain. Musnad-e-Ahmad mein hai Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain duniya mein momin ki teen qismein hain: 001 Woh jo Allah par aur us ke Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) par imaan laye shak shuba na kiya aur apni jaan aur apne maal se rah-e-Allah mein jihad kiya, 002 Woh jin se logon ne aman pa liya na yeh kisi ka maal maarein na kisi ki jaan lein, 003 Woh jo tama ki taraf jab jhankte hain Allah Azza-wa-Jal ki yaad karte hain. Phir farmata hai ke kya tum apne dil ka yaqeen-o-deen Allah ko dikhate ho? Woh toh aisa hai ke zameen-o-aasman ka koi zarra us se makhfi nahin woh har cheez ka janne wala hai. Phir farmaya jo A'raab apne Islam lane ka baar-e-ehsan tujh par rakhte hain un se keh do ke mujh par Islam lane ka ehsan na jatao tum agar Islam qabool karoge meri farman-bardari karoge meri madad karoge toh is ka nafa tumhein ko milega. Balkeh darasal imaan ki daulat tumhein dena yeh Allah hi ka ehsan hai agar tum apne dawe mein sache ho. (Ab gaur farmaiye ke kya Islam lane ka ehsan paighambar Allah par jatane wale sache musalman thay?)

Pas ayaat ki tarteeb se zahir hai ke un ka Islam haqeeqat par mabni na tha aur yehi alfaaz bhi hain ke imaan ab tak un ke zehan-nasheen nahin hua aur jab tak Islam haqeeqat par mabni na ho tab tak beshak woh imaan nahin lekin jab woh apni haqeeqat par sahih ma'ani mein ho to phir imaan Islam ek hi cheez hai. Khud is ayat ke alfaaz mein gaur farmaiye irshad hai apne Islam ka ehsaan tujh par rakhte hain halankeh darasal imaan ki hidayat Allah ka khud un par ehsaan hai. Pas wahan ehsaan-e-Islam rakhne ko bayan kar ke apna ehsaan-e-hidayat-e-imaan jatana bhi imaan-o-Islam ke ek hone par bareek ishara hai, mazeed dalail Sahih Bukhari Sharif waghera mulahiza hon mutarjim pas Allah Ta'ala ka kisi ko imaan ki raah dikhana us par ehsaan karna hai jaise ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hunain wale din Ansar se farmaya tha main ne tumhein gumrahi ki halat mein nahin paya tha? Phir Allah Ta'ala ne tum mein ittefaq diya tum muflis thay meri wajah se Allah ne tumhein maldar kiya jab kabhi Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) kuch farmate woh kehte beshak Allah aur us ka Rasool (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) us se bhi zyada ehsano wale hain. Bazzar mein hai ke Banu Asad Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ke paas aaye aur kehne lage Ya Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) hum musalman hue Arab aap se larte rahe lekin hum aap se nahin lare Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne farmaya in mein samajh bahut kam hai shaitan in ki zabanon par bol raha hai aur ye ayat (يَمُنُّوْنَ عَلَيْكَ اَنْ اَسْلَمُوْا ۭ قُلْ لَّا تَمُنُّوْا عَلَيَّ اِسْلَامَكُمْ ۚ بَلِ اللّٰهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ اَنْ هَدٰىكُمْ لِلْاِيْمَانِ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ 17؀) (Al-Hujurat: 17), nazil hui phir dobara Allah Rabbul Izzat ne apne wasee ilm aur apni sachi bakhabri aur makhlooq ke a'maal se agahi ko bayan farmaya ke aasman-o-zameen ke ghaib us par zahir hain aur woh tumhare a'maal se aagah hai Alhamdulillah Surah Hujurat ki tafsir khatam hui Allah ka shukar hai. Balkeh darasal imaan ki daulat tumhein dena yeh Allah hi ka ehsan hai agar tum apne dawe mein sache ho. (Ab gaur farmaiye ke kya Islam lane ka ehsan paighambar Allah par jatane wale sache musalman thay?)

Pas wahan ehsaan-e-Islam rakhne ko bayan kar ke apna ehsaan-e-hidayat-e-imaan jatana bhi imaan-o-Islam ke ek hone par bareek ishara hai, mazeed dalail Sahih Bukhari Sharif waghera mulahiza hon mutarjim pas Allah Ta'ala ka kisi ko imaan ki raah dikhana us par ehsaan karna hai jaise ke Rasool Allah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ne Hunain wale din Ansar se farmaya tha main ne tumhein gumrahi ki halat mein nahin paya tha?
